_comment: Golden-harness subset of the public NBA games dataset (games.csv, games_details.csv, teams.csv): every game dated in calendar 2016 or 2017, and one row per game for a cohort of the top 30 scorers of those two years plus named players the cases mention (LeBron James, Stephen and Seth Curry, Grant Jerrett, double-double and efficiency leaders) and two duplicate player names. `played` is 1 when the source COMMENT is blank (a DNP/DND row keeps its zero stats with played = 0). Reference SQL in ../../ask-golden/nba-*.json is evaluated against exactly these rows.
